name: Omarchy Super Switcher
author: jfdnet
description: Visual window and workspace switching for Omarchy (Orbit + Overview Workspaces) tuned for stock Hyprland: fast Alt+Tab activation without stalls, and switch targets land maximized in the Super+Alt+F style. Derived from ManateeLazyCat's omarchy-window-switcher.

barWidget.description: Workspace buttons, live overview, and visual window switching.
